# GMC motorhome asset attribution

This work is based on **“FREE GMC Motorhome reimagined low poly”** by **Karol Miklas**.

- Original model: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-gmc-motorhome-reimagined-low-poly-6hiH0iyDqXqtdD9wbqSbyLLhKmz
- Creator profile: https://sketchfab.com/karolmiklas
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Acquisition provenance: the creator-attributed CC-BY distribution retained in `nnj1/jarv` at commit `0537ef63007c7f5f435de0c570498fee9cc07d77`
- Local preparation: baked wheel pairs were separated for physics animation, a passenger doorway was opened for the traversable cabin, the source's duplicated oversized cockpit-seat assemblies were disconnected and replaced with correctly scaled runtime seats, and source textures were reduced to 1024 px for mobile GPU budgets. No authorship claim is made over the original geometry or texture art.

The in-game credits and repository documentation must retain this attribution.
